instruction: Apply both bold and italic styling to the titles of slides 1, 3, and 4.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires making titles in slides 1, 3, and 4 both bold and italic. Evaluator uses custom getter to extract title formatting (bold/italic status) from specified slides and custom metric to verify all three slides have correct formatting. Slide titles are: Slide 1='Goal Roadmap', Slide 3='Add a Roadmap Page', Slide 4='Add an Agenda Page'.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Each correctly formatted slide contributes 1/3 to the final score (partial credit enabled)
